definitions.explanation: Used to affirm something with confidence or to acknowledge a valid point.
Used when recalling something from memory that one believes to be accurate.

examples.japanese: {確|たし}かに⟦そのとおり→そのとおり：22252_sonotoori⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{確|たし}かに、⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: Indeed, that is a difficult problem.

examples.japanese: {確|たし}かに⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: It's certainly expensive, but the quality is very good.
examples.notes: Concessive use: acknowledges a point before contrasting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{確|たし}か→確か：00894_tashika⟧⟦{三時|さんじ}→三時：10983_sanji⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It was from three o'clock, if I remember correctly.
examples.notes: Without に: {確|たし}か means 'if I remember correctly.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{確|たし}か→確か：00894_tashika⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦{出身|しゅっしん}→出身：03221_shusshin⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: If I remember correctly, I think he was from Osaka.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{確|たし}か→確か：00894_tashika⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{近|ちか}く→近く：00923_chikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦はず→はず：01557_hazu⟧⟦だけど→だけど：00033_dakedo⟧、⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}せない→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm pretty sure that shop was near the station, but I can't quite remember the exact location.

notes:
{確|たし}かに is the adverbial form of ⟦{確|たし}か→確か：00894_tashika⟧ (certain). It has two main uses.

USAGE 1 - Affirmation:
When used to affirm something with certainty. Often appears at the beginning of a sentence to acknowledge a valid point.
- {確|たし}かに、⟦そのとおり→そのとおり：22252_sonotoori⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧: Indeed, that's right
- {確|たし}かに⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧: It's certainly difficult

USAGE 2 - Concession:
Acknowledges a point before introducing a contrasting idea (like "certainly...but...").
- {確|たし}かに⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: It's certainly expensive, but the quality is good

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{確|たし}か→確か：00894_tashika⟧ (without ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧): "if I remember correctly" - expresses uncertainty
- {確|たし}かに: expresses certainty or acknowledgment
- ⟦{本当|ほんとう}に→本当に：04714_hontouni⟧: really (emphasizes truth)
- ⟦もちろん→もちろん：01224_mochiron⟧: of course (stronger certainty)
